title: Raluca - First Meeting

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: What? Oh, the mask? You kind of get used to it... Kind of.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? Oh, the mask? You kind of get used to it... Kind of.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Never seen an Oxyphile before?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never seen an Oxyphile before?

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I'm an oxyphile actually so that's a pretty rough thing to say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm an oxyphile actually so that's a pretty rough thing to say?

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Oxyphiles have to keep these on at all times. I was born in the Spire, and my internals can't handle the polluted air down here. It’s either this or painful death.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oxyphiles have to keep these on at all times. I was born in the Spire, and my internals can't handle the polluted air down here. It’s either this or painful death.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I have to say, it's been a very long time since anyone here asked me a personal question.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have to say, it's been a very long time since anyone here asked me a personal question.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Not yet...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not yet...

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: They sure do. I guess the LUZ has people a little distracted too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They sure do. I guess the LUZ has people a little distracted too.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: My parents were killed in a terrorist attack on a Vinc tube when I was eight. Dad had a few generations of hidden debt, bingo-bango. I’m stuck down here paying it off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My parents were killed in a terrorist attack on a Vinc tube when I was eight. Dad had a few generations of hidden debt, bingo-bango. I’m stuck down here paying it off.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: He was actually a good man. not everyone in the Spire is heartless.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He was actually a good man. not everyone in the Spire is heartless.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: That's kind, but it's okay. Anyone who lives down here is dancing toe to toe with the darkness. Thankfully, I was born with two right feet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's kind, but it's okay. Anyone who lives down here is dancing toe to toe with the darkness. Thankfully, I was born with two right feet.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I guess you're right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: There have been a few half-baked attempts, but it's a complicated problem, so the Spire is still the only place with truly clean air.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There have been a few half-baked attempts, but it's a complicated problem, so the Spire is still the only place with truly clean air.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Very little is down here, but I have enjoyed meeting you. It's been a long time since I last talked about this stuff, it feels good. I hope we meet again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very little is down here, but I have enjoyed meeting you. It's been a long time since I last talked about this stuff, it feels good. I hope we meet again.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Something I can help you with?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Something I can help you with?

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Careful there, I might just take you up on that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Careful there, I might just take you up on that.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: If I didn't, this city would have scrambled me a long time ago.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I didn't, this city would have scrambled me a long time ago.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: See? Now you're getting it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See? Now you're getting it!

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I guess us ‘street-levels’ will just have to make do with what we have.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess us ‘street-levels’ will just have to make do with what we have.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That looks uncomfortable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That looks uncomfortable.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you wearing it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you wearing it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe just take it off?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe just take it off?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not that I can remember.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not that I can remember.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why did you have to leave the Spire?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why did you have to leave the Spire?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why did you have to leave the Spire?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why did you have to leave the Spire?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can tell you have some interesting answers. Would you like me to stop?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can tell you have some interesting answers. Would you like me to stop?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can tell you have some interesting answers. Would you like me to stop?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can tell you have some interesting answers. Would you like me to stop?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: People here have busy lives.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People here have busy lives.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So, the Spire?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, the Spire?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your dad should have paid his debts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your dad should have paid his debts.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Your dad should have paid his debts.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Your dad should have paid his debts.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm so sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm so sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If that were true, they'd have let you stay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If that were true, they'd have let you stay.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If that were true, they'd have let you stay.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If that were true, they'd have let you stay.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you think they'll ever fix the air down here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you think they'll ever fix the air down here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you think they'll ever fix the air down here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you think they'll ever fix the air down here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It doesn't seem fair.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It doesn't seem fair.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then maybe we should dance sometime?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then maybe we should dance sometime?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Then maybe we should dance sometime?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Then maybe we should dance sometime?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's nice you see the best in people.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's nice you see the best in people.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's nice you see the best in people.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's nice you see the best in people.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It could always be worse.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It could always be worse.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're a what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So why don't you return? You must be rich!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So why don't you return? You must be rich!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So why don't you return? You must be rich!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So why don't you return? You must be rich!
